namespaces.name: color
namespaces.description: Color management of the display: switch, display profile, view conversion.

verbs.name: set
verbs.description: Switches color management or sets the display profile, then prints the status.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).
Convert color images to the display profile.

options.label: <icc-file>
options.description: ICC profile file (.icc, .icm) of the display of this workstation.
No display profile: the display is sRGB.

verbs.name: status
verbs.description: Whether color management is on, the display profile, and the profile and conversion of a view.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

namespaces.name: config
namespaces.description: Site configuration documents and declared settings.

verbs.name: catalog
verbs.description: The declared settings with their type and scope.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <output-path>
options.description: File to write the catalog into instead of printing it.

verbs.name: export
verbs.description: Converts the legacy XML documents of a site package into JSON.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <folder>
options.description: Root of the resources package holding the XML documents (default: the current one).

options.label: <folder>
options.description: Folder to write the JSON documents into (default: the config folder of the preference directory).
Overwrite a JSON document that exists.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: The config folder of the resources package, the documents it holds, and the user and machine documents of this installation.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: pack
verbs.description: Writes the settings and documents of a layer into a package, to move them to another machine or to give them to Viewer Hub.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <layer>
options.description: user (default), machine, or site (the config folder of a resources package).
With a user package, also the settings and documents of this workstation.

options.label: <output-path>
options.description: The package to write (default: a dated name in the current folder).

verbs.name: reload
verbs.description: Re-reads every site and user document without restarting Weasis.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: setting
verbs.description: The value of a declared setting, where it comes from and whether it is locked.

parameters.label: <key>
parameters.description: Key of the setting, as listed by config:catalog.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: sync
verbs.description: Mirrors the user settings and documents with the preference service: sends what changed, and with --pull reads and merges the service's copy first.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).
Read and merge the service's copy before sending.

verbs.name: unpack
verbs.description: Imports a settings package after a backup of the current settings; --dry-run shows what would change.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: The package to import.
Replace each document and settings group of the package whole, instead of merging.
Show what would change, change nothing.

namespaces.name: dicom
namespaces.description: The DICOM explorer: loading, listing, opening and closing studies, and reading attributes.

verbs.name: info
verbs.description: Technical description of a series: modality, body part, image count, geometry and pixel spacing. Identifiers follow the identity policy.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID (or series id) from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list'; its selected pane gives the series.

verbs.name: interest
verbs.description: Images of interest of the loaded series: those a key object selection, an annotated presentation state or a segmentation points at, and those drawn on in Weasis, with their sources. Filter by study or by series.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID from 'dicom:list'; default: every loaded study.

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID (or series id) from 'dicom:list': this series only.
Also list the SOP Instance UIDs of the images of interest.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: Patients, studies and series loaded in the explorer, as JSON. Identifiers follow the identity policy; UIDs are the handles for the other verbs.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <n>
options.description: At most this many entries (default: all of them).

options.label: <n>
options.description: Skip the first n entries, as the previous answer's 'next' says.

verbs.name: load
verbs.description: Loads DICOM files from local paths, URLs, manifests, ZIP archives or the portable directories, and returns what was queued and how far the loading went.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A DICOM file or a directory (recursive).

options.label: <remote-url>
options.description: A DICOM file URL.

options.label: <remote-url>
options.description: An XML manifest (WADO).

options.label: <remote-url>
options.description: A ZIP archive of DICOM files.

options.label: <data>
options.description: An XML manifest encoded as GZIP then Base64.
The DICOM directories configured next to the executable.

options.label: <wait-level>
options.description: Answer when the loading reaches this point: none, first-series or all (default: none, or all when the option carries no value).

options.label: <seconds>
options.description: Give up waiting after this long (default: 600).

verbs.name: load-dicomweb
verbs.description: Loads DICOM studies through a DICOMweb service (QIDO/WADO-RS) and returns what was queued and how far the loading went.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <remote-url>
options.description: URL of the DICOMweb service.

options.label: <query>
options.description: Query parameters of the URL, see weasis-pacs-connector.

options.label: <header>
options.description: Custom header for every request.

options.label: <header>
options.description: Custom header for the query requests (QIDO).

options.label: <header>
options.description: Custom header for the retrieve requests (WADO).

options.label: <ext>
options.description: Additional query URL parameters (QIDO).

options.label: <ext>
options.description: Additional retrieve URL parameters (WADO).

options.label: <ext>
options.description: Parameters of the multipart/related Accept header (default: transfer-syntax=*).

options.label: <auth-uid>
options.description: UID of the Weasis authentication method.

options.label: <issuer>
options.description: Issuer identifier of the OpenID Connect authentication request.

options.label: <login>
options.description: Login hint of the end user (OpenID Connect).
When downloading a series, list the other series of the study, ready for download.

options.label: <wait-level>
options.description: Answer when the loading reaches this point: none, first-series or all (default: none, or all when the option carries no value).

options.label: <seconds>
options.description: Give up waiting after this long (default: 600).

verbs.name: objects
verbs.description: Non-image objects of the loaded studies (key object selections, presentation states, segmentations, RT objects): kind, label, date, creator and the series they reference. Filter by study, by referenced series or by kind. Labels follow the identity policy.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID from 'dicom:list'; default: every loaded study.

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID (or series id) from 'dicom:list': only the objects that reference this series.

options.label: <kind>
options.description: Only this kind: ko, rejection, pr, seg, rtstruct, rtplan, rtdose, other.

verbs.name: open
verbs.description: Opens a series: in the view given by --view, and in its pane given by --pane, in a new view of the type given by --viewer-type, or in the default viewer of its type. Returns the view id and what the viewer decided while opening (e.g. 'rectified', 'warnings'); the client option -y answers its questions instead of showing them.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID (or series id) from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' that receives the series.

options.label: <viewer-type>
options.description: Opens a new view of this type, by id from 'dicom:info' (e.g. 'mpr'), or by the name the interface shows.

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane of --view that receives the series, from 1 (default: the selected one).
Show the images of interest only (referenced by a KO, an annotated PR or a SEG, or drawn on); the whole series when it has none.

options.label: <wait-level>
options.description: Answer once the viewer has finished building its content, e.g. the MPR volume: none or all, since a viewer builds in one step (default: none, or all when the option carries no value).

verbs.name: tag
verbs.description: Value of a DICOM attribute of an image of the series, by keyword or (gggg,eeee). Identity attributes follow the identity policy; private tags are not exposed.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID (or series id) from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list'; its selected pane gives the series.

options.label: <dicom-keyword>
options.description: DICOM keyword (e.g. SliceLocation) or hexadecimal tag (gggg,eeee).

options.label: <image-index>
options.description: Image index in the series, from 1 (default: 1).

verbs.name: unload
verbs.description: Takes patients, studies or series out of the explorer and returns what was unloaded. Every handle is resolved first: an unknown one unloads nothing. A patient is named by the identifier 'dicom:list' returned, which is the masked one under a masking policy.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).
Unload every patient.

options.label: <patient-handle>
options.description: Patient identifier to unload, as 'dicom:list' returns it.

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID to unload.

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID, or series id, to unload.

namespaces.name: explorer
namespaces.description: The explorer panel: its filter facets, its selection and what it shows. 'dicom:' reads the data, 'explorer:' the view of it.

verbs.name: facets
verbs.description: The values the series filter can take for the selected patient, with the number of its series each value keeps: modalities, kinds of objects referencing the series, sources of images of interest, download states. The menu of the filter button shows the same; lets an agent choose a filter before 'explorer:filter'.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: filter
verbs.description: Sets the facets of the series filter of the DICOM explorer, combined with AND: text, study, modalities, kinds of objects referencing the series, download state. Without option, prints the current filter. Returns the filter and how many series of the selected patient pass it.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <text>
options.description: Free text over series and study attributes, anatomy and its region group.

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID from 'dicom:list': only its series; repeatable, as a selection on the timeline strip.

options.label: <modality>
options.description: Modalities to keep (repeatable, or comma-separated).

options.label: <kind>
options.description: Keep the series referenced by an object of one of these kinds: ko, pr, seg, rtstruct, rtplan, rtdose, rejection, other (repeatable, or comma-separated).

options.label: <download-state>
options.description: Download states to keep: complete, pending, downloading.

options.label: <interest-source>
options.description: Keep the series with images of interest: any, or pointed at by one of ko, graphics, pr, seg (repeatable, or comma-separated).
Clears every facet first.

verbs.name: mode
verbs.description: Sets how the DICOM explorer draws the selected patient: 'thumbnails' (the column of thumbnails) or 'list' (one row per series and per object, studies as group rows). Without argument, prints the current mode.

parameters.label: <explorer-mode>
parameters.description: thumbnails, list, or auto (forget the choice, let the rules decide).

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: reveal
verbs.description: Scrolls the DICOM explorer to a series and selects it, as a reader pointing at it: selects its patient, unfolds its study in the compact list and brings its thumbnail or row into view. Reports 'visible': false when the filter hides it (the filter is not changed).

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID (or series id) from 'dicom:list'.

verbs.name: select
verbs.description: Selects series in the DICOM explorer (and the patient they belong to), as a click would; the next 'dicom:open' without --series opens them. Returns the state.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID (or series id) from 'dicom:list'; repeatable.

verbs.name: state
verbs.description: What the DICOM explorer shows: the selected patient, the filter and its counts, the studies with their series (visible or filtered out, download state, selected) and their non-image objects. Identifiers follow the identity policy.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

namespaces.name: hp
namespaces.description: Hanging protocols: the protocols of every layer, the plan the engine computes for a loaded study, its hanging on live viewers, the active hanging of a viewer, and the validation of the protocols over a folder of studies.

verbs.name: apply
verbs.description: Hangs a protocol on a loaded study: computes its plan as 'match' does and opens the viewers of one reading step, the 2D cells in one viewer and each MPR or 3D cell in its own. A 2D viewer of the same patient is re-hung unless --new-tab. Returns the cells with the view ids they went to, so 'view2d:' verbs can address them.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Hangs this protocol from 'list' even when another one scores better.

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A JSON file of protocol entries used instead of the layers, to try a draft.

options.label: <step>
options.description: The reading step to hang, from 1 (default: the first).
Opens new viewers instead of re-hanging the one of the same patient.

options.label: <screen-role>
options.description: Opens the viewers of the step in a viewer window on the screen of this role (control, diagnostic-1, diagnostic-2, color, portrait, see 'workspace:screens').

verbs.name: compare
verbs.description: Hangs a study against the priors you name: the protocol (the best comparison one, or --protocol) is matched on --current with --prior as its only priors, and its first step is hung. Every study must be loaded.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: The current study, from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: A prior study of the same patient; repeatable.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Hangs this protocol from 'list' even when another one scores better.

verbs.name: correct
verbs.description: Puts another series of the study in a cell of the active hanging: the cell is re-hung with it, the correction is recorded with the rule that would have produced the choice, and --apply writes that rule into the protocol when it is a user one.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <cell>
options.description: The cell to correct, from 1.

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: Series Instance UID of the study, from 'dicom:list' or 'explain'.
Writes the proposed rule into the protocol (user protocols only).

verbs.name: corrections
verbs.description: The correction log: what users put in the cells instead of what the protocols chose, with the rule each correction proposes; --stats gives the anonymous counts per protocol, cell, display set and proposed rule (no study or series), the figures an administrator or the Viewer Hub collects to see which rules fail most.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Only the corrections of this protocol.
The anonymous statistics instead of the log.

verbs.name: delete
verbs.description: Deletes a protocol of the user layer, one saved with 'save'; a built-in or site protocol cannot be deleted, only disabled.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Protocol id from 'list'.

verbs.name: explain
verbs.description: Why the cells of the active hanging show what they show: per cell the rules that selected the series, its score and the alternatives; the why of a hanging.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <cell>
options.description: Only this cell, from 1.

verbs.name: export
verbs.description: Writes a protocol of any layer to a file: its JSON entry, or with --dicom a DICOM Hanging Protocol Storage object (also when the file ends with .dcm). The Weasis extensions (feature selectors, viewer types, display by reference, UI profile) travel in a private block of the object, or are dropped with --plain for a reader that must not see them.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Protocol id from 'list'.

options.label: <output-path>
options.description: Target file.
Writes a DICOM object instead of JSON.
Leaves the Weasis extensions out.

verbs.name: features
verbs.description: The series features the matching works on (modality, role, orientation, anatomy, laterality, view, contrast, MR weighting, CT kernel and family, thickness, spacing, temporal, images of interest...), per series of a loaded study or of a folder of studies: what a selector can test, and why a series matched or not.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A folder of DICOM studies read without a viewer, walked recursively.

verbs.name: group
verbs.description: Shows another reading step (presentation group) of the active hanging, or hangs another candidate protocol, on the same viewers.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).
The next step, the first one again after the last.
The previous step.

options.label: <step>
options.description: The step to show, from 1.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Hangs this candidate of the study instead, from its first step.

verbs.name: import
verbs.description: Reads a protocol file, a DICOM Hanging Protocol Storage object or a JSON entry (one, an array, or an object with 'protocols'), and stores the protocols in the user layer with their level; a protocol of the same id in the built-in or site layer is overridden by it. An object without the Weasis private block imports with its DICOM selectors alone, with a warning.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: Source file.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: The id to store a single imported protocol under.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: The protocols of every layer (built-in, site, user) with their level, whether they are enabled, and the number of image sets and display sets they declare.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: match
verbs.description: The hanging plan of a loaded study: the protocols that apply, best first, and the plan of the best one (or of --protocol): per reading step the layout to hang and, per cell, the series chosen, how it matched, why, and the alternatives. The study is --study, else the one of the series selected in the explorer, else the only loaded one.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Plans this protocol from 'list' even when another one scores better.

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A JSON file of protocol entries matched instead of the layers, to try a draft.

verbs.name: open
verbs.description: Opens a study hung by a protocol, the reading workflow in one call: the best protocol (or --protocol) is matched on the study with its priors, the older loaded studies of the patient, or only the ones --prior names, and its first step is hung. The study and its priors must be loaded ('dicom:get' first); the selective download of the hung series is not there yet.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: Study Instance UID from 'dicom:list'.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Hangs this protocol from 'list' even when another one scores better.

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: A prior study to compare with; repeatable. Default: every loaded prior.
Opens new viewers instead of re-hanging the one of the same patient.

verbs.name: save
verbs.description: Save as protocol: derives a user protocol from the display of a 2D viewer, per cell the smallest set of feature selectors that singles its series out among the study and the presentation of the cell (preset, color map, inversion, sort, tiling, synchronization), and stores it in the user layer; --dry-run only returns the rules and which loaded studies the protocol would apply to.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <text>
options.description: The protocol name; the id is derived from it unless --id.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: The entry id.
Derives and reports without storing; matches the loaded studies.

verbs.name: sets
verbs.description: The hanging a viewer is part of: the protocol, the reading step shown of how many, the display sets with their view ids, the candidates of the study.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

verbs.name: show
verbs.description: A protocol of the layers as its JSON entry: the DICOM part by keyword and the Weasis extensions (feature selectors, viewer types, display by reference).

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Protocol id from 'list'.

verbs.name: validate
verbs.description: Runs the matching over a folder of studies without a viewer and reports, per protocol, how many studies it applies to and how its cells matched (exact, preferred, fallback, shared, empty) and, per study, the protocol chosen: the regression test of a protocol library. The protocols are those of every layer, or the entries of --protocols.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A folder of DICOM studies, walked recursively.

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A JSON file of protocol entries checked for rule errors without any study: image set numbers unique and referenced, selectors known, one time-based item per set, grids the viewer offers.

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A JSON file holding protocol entries (an array, or an object with a 'protocols' array) validated instead of the layers.

options.label: <protocol-id>
options.description: Only this protocol.

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: A JSON file of expected hangings, {"studies": {"<study-uid>": {"protocol": <id>, "cells": {"1": <series-uid>}}}}: the report says per study whether the chosen protocol and the cells of its first step are the expected ones.

namespaces.name: image
namespaces.description: Loading and closing of plain images (non-DICOM) in the default viewer.

verbs.name: compare
verbs.description: Compares two image files pixel by pixel and returns how far apart they are: the number of pixels that differ, their share, and the largest and mean channel difference.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: First image.

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: Second image.

options.label: <n>
options.description: Channel difference below which two pixels count as equal, 0 to 255 (default: 0).

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: The groups and series of images opened in the default viewer, as JSON.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: load
verbs.description: Opens images from files or URLs and returns the series it opened.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: Image file to open.

options.label: <remote-url>
options.description: Image URL to download and open.

verbs.name: unload
verbs.description: Closes groups or images and returns what was closed; an unknown handle closes nothing.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).
Close every group.

options.label: <group>
options.description: Group to close, as 'image:load' returns it.

options.label: <series>
options.description: Series or image to close, as 'image:load' returns it.

namespaces.name: redact
namespaces.description: Regions burned over the pixels of a view, and the device library they can come from.

verbs.name: add
verbs.description: Hides an area of the selected view.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <image-rect>
options.description: Axis-aligned rectangle, in image pixels.

options.label: <image-rect>
options.description: Ellipse inscribed in this rectangle.

options.label: <image-polygon>
options.description: Closed outline as x,y pairs (three at least).

options.label: <scope>
options.description: Where it applies: IMAGE, SERIES.

verbs.name: apply
verbs.description: Hides the regions of a device entry on the selected view, all of them: a chosen entry is applied as it was drawn, where 'match' proposes only what the profile in force does not keep.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <entry-id>
options.description: Device entry from 'redact:library'.

options.label: <scope>
options.description: Where it applies: IMAGE, SERIES.

verbs.name: attest
verbs.description: Records that a person reviewed the pixels of the selected image or series and found no burned-in identity, so it may be captured or exported without a redaction; --withdraw takes it back. Held until the study is unloaded.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <scope>
options.description: Where it applies: IMAGE, SERIES.

options.label: <name>
options.description: Who reviewed the pixels; required unless --withdraw.

options.label: <text>
options.description: What the review was, such as the catalog and the date it was recorded.
Takes back the attestation of that scope.

verbs.name: clear
verbs.description: Removes the regions of the selected image or series.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

namespaces.name: state
namespaces.description: Reading states: keep the display as a session (windows, viewers, every pane's series and presentation, the shell, the protocol that hung it), list, restore and delete the sessions of the user.

verbs.name: delete
verbs.description: Deletes a session of the user.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <session-id>
options.description: Session id from 'list'.

verbs.name: export
verbs.description: Writes a session to a directory: its JSON (the sidecar as 'state:keep' stores it), or with --dicom a Basic Structured Display object laying out the panes of the 2D viewers of the main window as image boxes, each with a Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State carrying the pane's window, rotation, flip, inversion, magnification and graphics; the studies of the session must be loaded. What the object cannot carry (MPR and 3D views, other windows, hidden tabs, blends) is listed under 'warnings'.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <session-id>

options.label: <study-uid>

options.label: <output-path>

Writes DICOM objects instead of the JSON.

verbs.name: keep
verbs.description: Keep this display: saves the workspace as a session of the user (windows, viewers, the series and presentation of every pane, the shell, the protocol and step that hung it) and returns its id. The session holds study and series identifiers, never credentials.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <text>
options.description: A label for the list.
Keeps the session out of the retention by number.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: The sessions of the user, the most recently used first.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: restore
verbs.description: Restores a session when its studies are loaded: open views are reused, closed viewers are created again with their series and presentation, the shell follows. A study of the session that is not loaded is reported; load it first.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <session-id>
options.description: Session id from 'list'.

options.label: <study-uid>
options.description: The most recent session showing this study instead of an id.

namespaces.name: subtraction
namespaces.description: Derived series subtracting one series of a study from another (post-contrast minus pre-contrast), scrolled, windowed, measured and sent like any series.

verbs.name: create
verbs.description: Builds the series minus the mask as a new series of the study, pixel by pixel on the same grid (A - factor*B + offset, real values), and opens it in the selected pane. The same operands and options always give the same series.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: The series subtracted from, from 'dicom:list' (default: the series of the selected pane).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: The series subtracted, from 'dicom:list' (default: the series of the study without contrast agent, else the earliest compatible one).

options.label: <phase-index>
options.description: Phase of a dynamic series to subtract from, from 'subtraction:phases' (default: every slice of the series).

options.label: <phase-index>
options.description: Phase of the mask series to subtract (default: the first phase when the mask is the series itself).
Build one series per phase of the series minus the mask phase; the first one opens.
Open the result as a maximum intensity projection through all its slices.

options.label: <number>
options.description: Weight of the mask: 1 subtracts it fully, below 1 keeps part of the anatomy (default: 1).

options.label: <number>
options.description: Value added to every difference (default: 0).
Store the absolute difference.
Open with the signed window, negative differences visible, instead of black below zero.

options.label: <frames>
options.description: DSA: mask frames of the run itself, from 1 ('3', '2-4' averaged, '1,3,5'); the series is an X-ray run (default for a run: the frames its DICOM names, else frame 1).

options.label: <count>
options.description: DSA: time-interval mask, each frame minus the frame that many before it.

options.label: <rows,columns>
options.description: DSA: sub-pixel shift of the mask in pixels, down and right when positive.
Move the mask of each slice onto it by the translation phase correlation measures (default: what the pane previews, else off).

options.label: <region>
options.description: Weight the mask so that its mean equals the one of the series, over the whole slices or over a pixel rectangle 'x,y,width,height' of every slice: the dual-tracer normalization of nuclear medicine; overrides --factor.
Build the series without opening it.

verbs.name: delete
verbs.description: Removes a subtraction series from the explorer and its slices from the cache.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>

verbs.name: mask
verbs.description: Sets the mask of the X-ray run a pane shows, taken from its own frames, and previews the subtraction: one frame, several frames averaged, or a time-interval offset. The state of the pane comes back with the mask under 'subtraction'.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <frames>
options.description: Mask frame numbers from 1: one ('3'), a range averaged ('2-4') or a list ('1,3,5').

options.label: <count>
options.description: Time-interval mask: each frame minus the frame that many positions before it; negative for the frame after it.

verbs.name: phases
verbs.description: The phases of a dynamic series stored as one series (temporal position, trigger time, or repeated slice positions): what --phase and --mask-phase count.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: A series from 'dicom:list' (default: the series of the selected pane).

verbs.name: preview
verbs.description: Shows the series of a pane minus a mask live, slice by slice, before any series is built: a call starts the preview (with the proposed mask unless --mask), --mask and --factor change it, --off puts the plain series back. The state of the pane comes back with the preview under 'subtraction'.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>

options.label: <series-uid>
options.description: The series subtracted, from 'dicom:list' (default: the series of the study without contrast agent, else the earliest compatible one).

options.label: <number>
options.description: Weight of the mask, 1 subtracts it fully (default: 1).
Moves the mask of each slice onto it by the translation phase correlation measures (true when given without a value; false switches it off).
Leaves the preview, the plain series stays shown.

verbs.name: shift
verbs.description: Moves the mask of the X-ray run a pane shows by a sub-pixel shift, to correct the patient's motion between the mask and the contrast frames, and previews the subtraction. Positive values move the mask down and to the right.

options.description: Horizontal shift of the mask in pixels (default: unchanged).

namespaces.name: ui
namespaces.description: The workspace around the viewers: the UI profiles (shell slots, toolbars, menus, mouse bindings, measurement profile) that a hanging protocol or a reading step lays over it, the overflow of what the selected view hides, and the catalog of every action of the workspace (menu entries, toolbar buttons, tool panels). Profile ids come from 'ui:profiles', action ids from 'ui:actions'.

verbs.name: action
verbs.description: Runs one action of 'ui:actions' by id, as its menu entry, button or stripe click would, and returns the active profile, the shell and the toolbar row after it.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <action-id>
options.description: From 'actions'.

verbs.name: actions
verbs.description: The actions of the workspace as the command palette lists them: the menu entries, the toolbar buttons and the tool panels of the selected viewer, with a stable id, the group, the shortcut and whether the selected view shows them ('relevant'; a hidden one still runs). In text a hidden action is marked with '-'.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <text>
options.description: Keeps the actions whose label, group or id contain every word, best first.
Keeps the actions the selected view shows.

verbs.name: context
verbs.description: The context of the selected view (its facts), the UI profile in force with its entry, the shell and the toolbar row, what the view hides, and the actions the view shows with their action command when they have one; what an agent needs to pick the next verb.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: profile
verbs.description: One UI profile as its JSON entry; --apply lays it over the workspace of the selected viewer until the next selection asks for another, --clear puts the user's own settings back, --delete removes the entry of the user layer. After a change the active profile, the shell and the toolbar row are returned.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <ui-profile-id>
options.description: Profile id from 'profiles'.
Lays --id over the workspace now.
Releases the active profile.
Removes --id from the user layer.

verbs.name: profiles

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: reveal
verbs.description: Shows again, for the selected view only, a toolbar or a tool panel that the view's context or the UI profile hides (the overflow 'More tools...' of the toolbar row); the next view hides it again. The hidden ids are under 'hidden' in the state the verbs of this namespace return.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <toolbar-id>
options.description: Toolbar id from 'hidden.toolbars'.

options.label: <tool-id>
options.description: Tool id from 'hidden.tools'.

namespaces.name: view2d
namespaces.description: Display of a 2D DICOM view: zoom, window/level, pan, scrolling, grid, mouse action, and the agent verbs capture, stats and measure. Every verb works on the pane given by --view and --pane, the selected one by default, and returns its display state.

verbs.name: annotate
verbs.description: Adds a text annotation on the AI layer of a pane: with --at it points at that place with an arrow, with --label-at alone it is a caption, text where you put it and nothing else drawn.

options.label: <view-id>

options.label: <pane-index>

options.label: <image-point>
options.description: Place the annotation points at; without it the text stands alone.

options.label: <text>
options.description: Text to show.

options.label: <image-point>
options.description: Position of the text itself (default: above and right of --at).
Coordinates are canvas pixels (as in a capture) instead of image pixels.

verbs.name: capture
verbs.description: Renders a view as displayed (window/level, annotations, identity masking) into a PNG or JPEG file and returns how image pixels map to the capture; --frame image renders the image alone at its own size, for exact comparisons.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>

options.description: Downscale so the file has at most this many pixels (default: 2000000 for the canvas, none for the image frame).

options.label: <frame>
options.description: canvas (default): the pane as displayed, its size and zoom; image: one pixel per displayed image pixel, whatever the pane, the zoom and the pan.

options.label: <on|off>
options.description: Text, scale, orientation, drawings and cross-lines: on or off (default: as displayed for the canvas, off for the image frame).

verbs.name: clear-ai

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

verbs.description: Mirrors the image of a pane and returns its display state; with no argument the state is returned unchanged. A vertical flip is the horizontal one turned by 180°, the form DICOM presentation states use.

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <flip-axis>
options.description: horizontal or vertical (default: horizontal).

verbs.name: fusion
verbs.description: Blends another series of the study over the one a pane shows (PET over CT, SPECT over MR...): --series starts or replaces the overlay, --color-map and --opacity change the blend, --off removes it; the display state returns the blend under 'blend'. With no argument the state is returned unchanged.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>

options.description: The overlay series, from 'dicom:list'; it must share the frame of reference.

options.label: <color-map-id>
options.description: Color map of the overlay, from 'color:maps'.
Opacity of the overlay, 0 transparent to 1 opaque.
Removes the overlay.

verbs.name: graphics
verbs.description: Lists the graphics of the view: id, type, layer, vertices and measurements, so measured values come from the viewer rather than from a picture.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>

options.label: <layer-name>

Skip the measurement values.

options.label: <n>
options.description: At most this many entries (default: all of them).

options.label: <n>
options.description: Skip the first n entries, as the previous answer's 'next' says.

options.label: <n>

options.label: <n>
options.description: Returns the best grid for this number of panes without applying it.

options.label: <cell>

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>

verbs.name: scroll
verbs.description: Moves through the images of the series a pane shows; with no argument the current position is returned unchanged.

options.label: <view-id>

options.label: <pane-index>

options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>

Coordinates are canvas pixels (as in a capture) instead of image pixels.

verbs.name: sync
verbs.description: Sets how the panes of a viewer follow each other and returns its state: none turns the synchronization off, another mode turns it on; with no argument the state is returned unchanged.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <sync-mode>
options.description: none, stack or tile, among the modes the viewer offers.

verbs.name: viewport
verbs.description: Viewport of a pane: --tiled shows its series on a grid of tiles, --stack returns it to one image; the state of the viewer, with its cells, is returned. With no argument the state is returned unchanged.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <cols>x<rows>
options.description: Shows the series of the pane on this grid of tiles, successive images.
Returns the pane to a single image.

verbs.name: window-level
verbs.description: Window and level of a pane: absolute with --window and --level, relative with --window-by and --level-by in slider steps (range 4096). With no argument the state is returned unchanged.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <window-width>
options.description: Width of the window, in the unit of the pixels.

options.label: <window-center>
options.description: Centre of the window, in the unit of the pixels.

options.label: <steps>
options.description: Widens the window by this many slider steps, negative to narrow it.

options.label: <steps>
options.description: Raises the level by this many slider steps, negative to lower it.

verbs.name: zoom
verbs.description: Changes the zoom of a pane and returns its display state; with no argument the state is returned unchanged.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: Viewer id from 'workspace:list' (default: the selected viewer).

options.label: <pane-index>
options.description: Pane index in the viewer layout, from 1 (default: the selected pane).

options.label: <magnification>
options.description: Magnification, 1 being one image pixel per canvas pixel.

options.label: <zoom-fit>
options.description: default, real-size or best-fit.

options.label: <steps>
options.description: Moves the zoom slider by this many steps, negative to zoom out.

namespaces.name: view3d
namespaces.description: Volume rendering: the capabilities of the renderer on this machine.

verbs.name: info
verbs.description: Reports whether volume rendering is available here, the binding and the context it runs on, the graphics adapter and the limits that decide the rendering path.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

namespaces.name: weasis
namespaces.description: The application itself: version, installation and the main window.

verbs.name: info
verbs.description: Version and installation details, the version being one of the keys. The 4.x option -v still answers with the version alone.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: minimize
verbs.description: Minimizes the main window and returns its state.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: quit
verbs.description: Shuts Weasis down and returns once the reply is written; a remote caller confirms with -y, and the instance may forbid it.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: show
verbs.description: Brings the main window to the front and returns its state.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

namespaces.name: workspace
namespaces.description: Layout of the viewer workspace: windows, tab groups and views. View ids come from 'workspace:list'; verbs that change the layout return the new state with --json.

verbs.name: close
verbs.description: Closes a view (fails when the view is not closable).

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.

verbs.name: context
verbs.description: What is displayed and why, as the tools of the plugins see it: the type of the selected viewer, its selected series and the facts the plugins contribute about them (the hanging protocol and its step, the series features). An agent reads it to know which tools and verbs apply.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

verbs.name: detach
verbs.description: Floats a view in its own window: a viewer window, which shows the toolbar row while it is the active one. Without option the window opens near the main window; --screen fills the usable area of the screen of that role (see 'screens'), --bounds gives explicit pixels.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.

options.label: <screen-rect>
options.description: Screen bounds of the new window, as x,y,width,height.

options.label: <screen-role>
options.description: Screen by role: control, diagnostic-1, diagnostic-2, color, portrait.

verbs.name: fullscreen
verbs.description: Puts a window on the full bounds of its monitor without decorations: the window of --view, else the active window. --off ends it. A window state, kept by 'workspace:save' and restored by 'workspace:load'.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list' whose window is meant (default: the active one).
Ends the fullscreen state of that window.
The selected pane of the view alone fills the viewer, the window and the monitor (what F11 and a double click do); --off ends it.

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: Windows, tab groups and views as JSON.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <n>
options.description: At most this many entries (default: all of them).

options.label: <n>
options.description: Skip the first n entries, as the previous answer's 'next' says.

verbs.name: load
verbs.description: Restores a layout captured by 'workspace:save': open views are reused, closed viewers are created again with their series and presentation when the series are still loaded; the shell (explorer and tool slots) follows when the snapshot has one.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <input-path>
options.description: Snapshot file to restore.

verbs.name: maximize
verbs.description: Shows a view alone in its window.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.

verbs.name: move
verbs.description: Moves the window of a view to the screen of a role (its usable area, see 'screens'); the main window moves too. Ends the fullscreen state of that window.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.

options.label: <screen-role>
options.description: Screen by role: control, diagnostic-1, diagnostic-2, color, portrait.

verbs.name: panel
verbs.description: Shell slots around the workspace: the explorer side (leading) and the tools side (trailing), two stacked slots each, and the central strip. Without option it returns the shell state; --side selects a side, then --slot with --tool or --clear fills or empties a slot, --collapse / --expand hide or show the side, --width and --ratio size it. Tool ids are stable across viewer types; an id the side does not offer now fails and lists the ones it does.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <side>
options.description: Side by role: EXPLORER, TOOLS.

options.label: <slot>
options.description: Slot of the side: TOP, BOTTOM.

options.label: <tool-id>
options.description: Opens this tool in --slot of --side, replacing what was there.
Empties --slot of --side.
Hides --tool of --side for good: the user's choice, kept in the setting weasis.tool.<id>.visible (see config:setting), until --show.
Shows --tool of --side again after --hide.
Shows --tool of --side as a tab of the active window instead of a slot, where it gets width and floats like any view; --tool with --slot brings it back.
Hides both slots of --side (tools remembered).
Shows the remembered tools of --side again.

options.label: <pixels>
options.description: Content width of --side, in pixels.

options.label: <split-ratio>
options.description: Share of the top slot of --side when both slots are shown.

options.label: <tool-id>
options.description: Keeps the central strip on this tool (fails when another tool is shown).
Empties the central strip.

verbs.name: save
verbs.description: Captures the layout as JSON, inline or to a file.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <output-path>
options.description: Write the snapshot to this file and report its path.
Replace the file when it exists and was not written by this session.

verbs.name: screens
verbs.description: The screens of the workstation by role (control, diagnostic-1, diagnostic-2, color, portrait) with the monitor each one resolves to: the main window's screen is the control screen, the others are derived left to right, and a role the user gave a monitor on the Screens preference page wins. A role without a monitor of its own resolves to the nearest one and is reported as not fulfilled. --id with --role gives a monitor a role, --id with --auto takes it back.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <screen-id>
options.description: A screen id from the listing, to give it a role or take it back.

options.label: <screen-role>
options.description: The role of --id: control, diagnostic-1, diagnostic-2, color, portrait.
Clears the role of --id; it is derived again.

verbs.name: select
verbs.description: Brings a view to the front of its tab group.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.

verbs.name: split
verbs.description: Places a view next to another view in a new split.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View whose group is split.

options.label: <side>
options.description: Side of the anchor for the new group: TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT, RIGHT.

options.label: <split-ratio>
options.description: Share of the space given to the anchor (default: 0.5).

verbs.name: stack
verbs.description: Moves a view into the tab group of another view.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View whose tab group receives the view.

verbs.name: unmaximize
verbs.description: Ends the maximized state of a view.

options.description: Structured JSON output (default for remote calls).

options.label: <view-id>
options.description: View id from 'workspace:list'.
